City of Encinitas
Youth Commission Regular Meeting
AGENDA
SEPTEMBER 3, 2025 -
04:30 PM
City of Encinitas - Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Ave
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the Commission.
1.
CALL TO ORDER
2.
ROLL CALL
3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
4.
SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS AND PROCLAMATIONS
4A.
Sister City Presentation, Supervisor White
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF (30 MINUTES)
6.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA Announce administrative changes to the agenda in compliance with the Brown Act.
7.
APPROVAL OF THE JUNE 4, 2025 YOUTH COMMISSION REGULAR MEETING MINUTES
Approve the June 4, 2025 Youth Commission Regular Meeting Minutes.
June 4, 2025 Regular Meeting Minutes
8.
APPROVAL OF THE AUGUST 20, 2025, YOUTH COMMISSION ORIENTATION WORKSHOP MINUTES
Approve the August 20, 2025 Youth Commission Orientation Workshop Minutes.
August 20, 2025 Orientation Workshop Minutes
9.
ACTION ITEMS
9A.
Youth Commission Chair and Vice Chair
Elect the Fiscal Year 2025-26 Chair and Vice Chair to serve one term.
2025-09-03 Item 9A. Youth Commission Chair and Vice Chair
9B.
Fiscal Year 2025-26 Youth Commission Work Plan Preparation
Review a list of potential work plan initiatives and begin work on the plan and assignment of Youth Commission representatives (maximum of four (4) commissioners per initiative).
2025-09-03 Item 9B. Youth Commission Work Plan
9C.
Fiscal Year 2025-26 Youth Commission Meeting Calendar
Adopt the proposed FY 2025-26 Youth Commission meeting calendar.
2025-09-03 Item 9C. Youth Commission Meeting Calendar
9D.
Youth Commission Alternates Amendment
Review and vote on a recommendation to the City Council regarding the proposed Ordinance No. 2025-09 amendment.
2025-09-03 Item 9D. Youth Commission Alternates Amendment
10.
INFORMATIONAL ITEMS
10A.
Department Updates - Recreation Services Manager Hamer
11.
COMMISSION MEMBER INITIATED AGENDA ITEM Commissioner prepared and presented agenda items.
12.
FUTURE AGENDA ITEMS ADDED BY COMMISSION MEMBERS Items added with consensus of two or more Commissioners.
13.
COMMISSIONER REPORTS Roundtable - All Commissioners
14.
ADJOURNMENT
